verdicts.reason: A: the headline's 'on 100 marathons' runs into the lime circle, putting white text on a light background with very poor contrast. 'Full review inside.' also sits on the bottom edge of the circle, and the lower ~40% of the canvas is empty. The NEW VIDEO badge is crammed into the top-right corner. B: the stack reads cleanly from logo and badge to a large headline, then the circle and shoe, then the subline. There are no collisions and the brand colours and proportions are kept. Small fixes: the VOLTSTRIDE logo is a bit small, and 'Full review inside.' sits tight against the circle and the bottom margin.
